name: Mikadomairi Koutarou
source:
Hobbies: Fighting
Favorite Food: Beef Jerky
Least Favorite Food: Raw Vegetables 
Favorite Animal: Polar Bears 
Least Favorite Animal: Snakes
Favorite Motto: Walls are meant to be crossed.

Second year high school student, member of the kendo club.
At his core he is a serious person, but somehow people think he is a delinquent, but he himself doesn't realize he's known like that.
